name: Gel Bead Blaster Rifle (Tan)
description: A tan gel bead blaster with an electric burst mode and a manual single-shot mode. The full kit adds a drum magazine, scope, holographic sight, flashlight, laser, angled grip and front and rear sights. For teens and adults; children under 14 need adult supervision, and eye protection must be worn. Looks realistic: don't carry or use it in public.

source.notes: Owner to confirm with the clearing agent that a realistic toy rifle can clear Nigerian Customs before any stock or publishing. Store return rate 32% (over the 30% flag). 7K+ sold. Tan full-kit style only (supplier style M416 full kit, 100x29.5x5.5 cm); owner gave the cost as 170 CNY, but the page's range tops out at 166.4 CNY, so confirm. FX 222.63 from the page (12,155.77 / 54.6). Free shipping within China. Lithium battery: sea freight only (ships_by_air false), as for the other blasters. Supplier bundles a free small sniper toy, a pistol toy and a target: left out of the listing and copy. Whether gel beads, battery and charger come in the box is not shown for this style: not claimed. Supplier photos are 800 px with Chinese text and a bonus panel burned in; automatic cut-out dropped the long barrel cover, so no store photo yet. Supplier title uses brand and model names: none used here. No safety certification shown or claimed.
